notes: Named-lead control packet. Preserves OSINTdefender's attributed April 3 reporting while explicitly preventing an attributed search/capture appeal from becoming a factual capture assertion or carrier misconduct finding.

information_events.exact_statement: OSINTdefender reported that Iran's state-run Mehr News Agency was calling on civilians to help capture the pilot and weapons officer of an American F-15E that was allegedly shot down over southern Iran.

public_receipts.text_excerpt: Iran’s state-run Mehr News Agency calls on Iranian civilians to help capture the pilot and weapons officer ... allegedly shot down...

information_events.plain_english_verdict: This is attributed, qualified reporting about an active search for missing aircrew. It does not assert that either airman had actually been captured and earns no adverse behavior finding.
information_events.originating_claimant: Mehr News Agency / Iranian public capture appeal
information_events.canonical_combined_assessment: SUPPORTED CONTEXT — AIRMAN WAS MISSING/EVADING AT PUBLICATION TIME; CARRIER DID NOT ASSERT CAPTURE AS FACT
information_events.provenance_limit: The post establishes OSINTdefender's public wording and attribution. It does not independently establish every detail in Mehr's underlying report.
